header.running_head: The Manner in which Hadhrat Umar Faarooq (RA) Distributed Wealth

blocks.text: the veterans of Badr and four thousand for those who had accepted Islaam before the veterans of Badr (but had not participated in the Battle of Badr). He stipulated an allowance of twelve thousand for all the wives of Rasulullaah ﷺ besides Hadhrat Safiyya (RA) and Hadhrat Juwayriyya (RA), for whom he had stipulated six thousand. However, the two ladies refused to accept the amount. Hadhrat Umar (RA) explained that he was giving more to the others because they had made Hijrah whereas the two of them had not. They argued, "You have not stipulated their share because of their Hijrah. You have stipulated a share for them because of their relationship with Rasulullaah ﷺ and we all share the same relationship." Hadhrat Umar (RA) thought the matter over and then stipulated an equal allowance (of twelve thousand) for them all.

Hadhrat Umar (RA) also stipulated an allowance of twelve thousand for Hadhrat Abbaas bin Abdil Muttalib (RA) because of his relationship with Rasulullaah ﷺ. Furthermore, he stipulated four thousand for Hadhrat Usaama bin Zaid (RA) and five thousand each for Hadhrat Hasan (RA) and Hadhrat Husayn (RA), an amount equal to that which their father (Hadhrat Ali (RA)) received because of their relationship (as grandsons) to Rasulullaah ﷺ. When he stipulated for his son Abdullaah (RA) three thousand, his son said, "Dear father! You have stipulated (four thousand) for Usaama (RA) and only three thousand for me whereas his father had no more status than my father and he has no more status than I?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied, "His father was more beloved to Rasulullaah ﷺ than your father and he was more beloved to Rasulullaah ﷺ than you."

Hadhrat Umar (RA) also stipulated two thousand for the sons of every veteran of Badr. When Umar the son of Hadhrat Abu Salamah (RA) passed by, Hadhrat Umar (RA) instructed his servants to give him an additional thousand. To this, Hadhrat Muhammad the son of Hadhrat Abdullaah (bin Jahash) (RA) enquired, "Why are you giving him more than us when his father had no more status than our fathers?" Hadhrat Umar (RA) replied, "I stipulated two thousand for him because of (his father) Abu Salamah (RA) and then increased a further thousand because of (his mother) Ummu Salamah (RA) (the wife of Rasulullaah ﷺ). If you had a mother like Ummu Salamah, I would have also given you another thousand."

While Hadhrat Umar (RA) stipulated eight hundred for Hadhrat Uthmaan bin Ubaydullaah (RA) the brother of Hadhrat Talha bin Ubaydullaah (RA), he stipulated two thousand for Hadhrat Nadhar bin Anas (RA). To this, Hadhrat Talha bin Ubaydullaah (RA) remarked, "When someone like Uthmaan (bin Ubaydullaah) comes to you, you stipulate eight hundred for him but when a youngster from the Ansaar comes to you, you include him amongst those who receive two thousand?"
